latestVersion.changelog:
seedance-video-editor 1.0.0

- Initial release of Seedance Video Editor: edit and export clips at up to 1080p MP4 in minutes.
- Supports script-driven edits: trim, cut, merge, add effects, title cards, and export via plain-text instructions—no manual timeline needed.
- Automatic session and API token management; works for both anonymous and registered users.
- Cloud GPU rendering for fast MP4 exports; handles clips under 5 minutes with typical turnaround under 2 minutes.
- Clear user prompts, robust error handling, and troubleshooting tips included in the docs.
